property_summary: The reference contract calls transferFrom(from, _tos[i], v) for every recipient index i in [0, _tos.length), so for every recipient a recording counterparty must observe at least one call; the mutant starts at i = 1, skipping the first recipient, so the first recipient receives no call.
change_summary: Change the loop initialization from i = 0 to i = 1, so the first recipient is skipped and a different set of external calls is made.
